title: OpenMessage Archive export records
description: Every JSON document of an export: a JSON Lines line (header, item or version), json/conversations.json, json/handles.json, or a single-file export. Open: consumers must accept unknown keys and unknown code tokens (every token travels with its numeric code).

decimal.description: A raw integer or an archive id as a decimal string (RFC 7493 2.2).

realDecimal.description: A real number as stored, in its shortest round-trip form.

line.description: One line of a c<nnnn>.jsonl or no-conversation.jsonl file.
